title: Result folder manifest
description: Each new result folder results/<module>/<run id>/ must contain manifest.json that agrees with this schema. Rule 5.6.1 of the clean-up proposal of 23 Oct 2026: no manifest, no result. Checked by registry/check_project.py.

run_id.description: Same as the folder name. No version suffix (-v2, -FINAL); a new version is a new run id that supersedes the old one.

module.description: Module name; must be a key of modules in registry/modules.yaml. Same as the parent folder name.

dirty.description: true if the code had uncommitted changes when the run started

configuration.description: The run configuration: either the full object, or a file in the result folder with its SHA-256.

inputs.description: Every input by registry id. An empty list is permitted only if the run has no data input.

outputs.description: Every output file. Path relative to the result folder, or ROOT:relative path for a large file kept in the exchange folder (root EX).

artifact_version_id.description: Platform artifact version id of a copy, if one exists. The copy is not the source.

thread_id.description: Session (frame) id of the thread that made the result.

status.description: A new result starts as UNCHECKED. Only an independent verifier sets CURRENT (rule 5.6.4).

verified_by.description: Thread id of the independent verifier. Required if status is CURRENT.

superseded_by.description: Registry id or run id of the newer result.

footnote.description: Chart footnote fields from the run (prior track, data option, ocean model, exclusions). Optional.
